loglevel.description: Log verbosity level: none, error, warning, info, debug, verbose

plugin_dir.description: Path to directory containing nbdkit plugin shared libraries

threads.description: Number of worker threads to handle client connections

maxconnections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections

idle_timeout.description: Seconds before an idle connection is closed (0 = disable)

plugin_sections.description: List of plugin configuration sections (one per exported NBD server)

name.description: Unique identifier for this plugin/export (also used as section name)

options.description: Key-value configuration parameters specific to the plugin (e.g., path, exportname, readonly)
